Auburn has a lot of hype, but will they live up to it?

Auburn is hyped pretty high but I'm buying into it. Yes, they're replacing QB and their top 2 RBs but, like the article states, Malzahn offenses are pretty worry-free. On the flipsize, Muschamp defenses are farily worry-free as well, so I'd say the pairing is perfect and should allow Auburn to live up to the hype.

I do agree that we're in an "anybody but Bama" rut and that makes it easy to overhype other teams. I do actually think Auburn may have the better team this year but Alabama will clearly be no slouch. I'm as guilty as anybody in picking "anybody but Bama", I just happen to believe it this year.

I would say on paper Auburn deserves the hype it is getting and should be picked high. But it is still the SEC West and in the down years for teams people arise that seem to come out of nowhere (almost every year).

I agree. I was very impressed with Jeremy Johnson when he played against us last year. He may not have been as mobile as Nick Marshall, but in my opinion he has a better arm and accuracy. I don't expect much drop-off on offense. And with almost all of the defensive starters returning plus Muschamp as DC, the hype is real.

The fire/water aspect also has some nice yin/yang like symmetry.
